messages:
mina_sales: Heads-up: ZephyrTech submitted an RFP. They want a short capability matrix (hosted/dedicated/private), POC schedule, embedding perf targets (2M/day, p95 <120ms for 1536d) and licensing for curated weights in customer VPC. Need a 1-page reply by EOD tomorrow.

rachel_pm: I created a folder and uploaded the RFP: https://redwood.internal/drive/zephyrtech/rfp (internal). Will add an 'asks' sheet with legal questions flagged.

upload-bot: File uploaded: zephyr_rfp_package.zip (uploaded by rachel_pm) :package:

oscar_se: Quick feasibility note: 120ms p95 is achievable on Dedicated with batch tuning. Hosted can hit ~90-110ms p95 on optimized pools; Dedicated gives predictable SLOs. Recommend Dedicated 2x A100-80gb with autoscale to 4, batch target 32, KV cache on.

devon_ml: Lab bench: embed-pro-1536 on a100-80gb: batch=32 p95 ~82ms, batch=16 p95 ~95ms, batch=1 p95 ~220ms under load. Cost rough: hosted optimized ~ $0.0009/embedding; dedicated commit reduces to ~$0.0006. Note: dropping to 1024 dims reduces latency ~25% and cost similarly.

liam_security: Compliance bullets for RFP: SOC2 Type II available for hosted; Dedicated/Private supports CM KMS (HSM add-on), VPC peering, audit logs (90/365d), and we can provide standard data processing agreement language. Hosted default: no persistent customer data retention unless opted in.

mina_sales: @oscar_se @devon_ml please paste a small config + 2-row capability matrix we can send. Also, legal needs a short licensing sentence for curated weights in Private.

oscar_se: Snippet for RFP: ```
recommended_dedicated:
  instance: a100-80gb
  replicas: 2
  autoscale_max: 4
  batch_target: 32
  kv_cache: enabled
  quant_profile: q4_0
```

oscar_se: Licensing blurb: "Redwood grants redistributable rights for Redwood-curated model variants under an Enterprise License for Private deployments; third-party weights require customer-provided licensing evidence."

devon_ml: I'll drop a mini benchmark table into the drive (batch 1/16/32 for 1024/1536 dims) and call out trade-offs: batching reduces cost but may increase p95 on spikes.

liam_security: Also clarify log retention & IP protection: Hosted: ephemeral debug logs (retained short-term); Dedicated: configurable audit logs; Private: customer-controlled. We'll attach policy excerpts.

rachel_pm: Drafting the capability matrix and a 3-week POC timeline: Week0 onboarding, Week1 smoke perf, Week2 tuning, Week3 final eval + report. Kickoff proposed Thu 9am PT.

mina_sales: Awesome. Action items: oscar finalize the RFP PDF, devon upload benchmark table, liam attach SOC2 snippet, legal to review license blurb. I'll send to ZephyrTech after legal signoff. :thumbsup:
